events.title: Eastern Market — Weekend Market & Flea
events.description: Historic public market plus weekend outdoor flea, arts, and crafts. Live music when weather permits.

events.title: Capitol Hill Farmers Markets
events.description: Seasonal weekend farmers markets with local produce and vendors.

events.title: Lincoln Park
events.description: Large Capitol Hill green space with playground, paths, and statues. Dog-friendly. Cafes at both ends.

events.title: Garfield Park
events.description: Neighborhood park with playground, tennis, basketball, bocce, and a community garden.

events.title: Yards Park & Navy Yard Waterfront
events.description: Riverfront park with fountains, boardwalk, and frequent seasonal weekend programming.

events.title: National Mall & Smithsonian Museums
events.description: Free Smithsonian museums and monuments. Reliable all-weather, all-ages option.

events.title: United States Botanic Garden
events.description: Free conservatory and gardens at the foot of the Capitol, with a Children's Garden.

events.title: Anacostia Riverwalk Trail Ride
events.description: Paved riverfront trail for a family bike ride, with Capital Bikeshare access nearby.

events.title: The Fields at RFK — Community Open Play & Disc Golf
events.time: Open hours vary (8 AM–dusk disc golf)
events.venue: The Fields at RFK Campus (401 Oklahoma Ave NE)
events.description: Turf fields with community open-play hours plus DC's free disc golf course. 10-min walk from Stadium-Armory.

events.title: CHAW Gallery (Capitol Hill Arts Workshop)
events.venue: Capitol Hill Arts Workshop (545 7th St SE)
events.description: Rotating gallery shows of local artists, two blocks from Eastern Market. Check site for current exhibition.

events.title: Escape with Washington Improv Theater
events.description: WIT's 'Escape with Washington Improv Theater' summer series runs Saturdays at Studio Theatre (1501 14th St NW). Three shows available on Aug 1: 4 PM, 6 PM, and 8 PM. Completely unscripted long-form improv comedy from DC's premier improv company. Pay-what-you-can pricing; door tickets are $20.

events.title: Mubadala Citi DC Open (Final Weekend)
events.venue: William H.G. FitzGerald Tennis Center, Rock Creek Park
events.description: Final weekend of DC's premier professional tennis tournament, drawing top ATP and WTA players competing for 500 ATP ranking points. One of DC's longest-standing sports traditions.

events.title: Otakon 2026
events.description: Family-friendly anime, manga, music, movies, and video games convention dedicated to fans of Asian pop culture and entertainment. One of the largest anime conventions on the East Coast.

events.title: Escape with Washington Improv Theater
events.description: WIT's ongoing Saturday improv series continues at Studio Theatre. Long-form unscripted comedy by DC's most experienced improvisers. Multiple showtimes. Pay-what-you-can; $20 door price.

events.title: Great American Farmers Market on the National Mall (Weekend Days)
events.venue: National Mall, 1400 Independence Ave SW (near Smithsonian Metro)
events.description: Weeklong celebration of American agriculture during National Farmers Market Week, in honor of America's 250th anniversary. Features 80+ vendors from 28 states offering produce, artisan goods, meats, farm-fresh dairy, live music, cooking demos, and family-friendly programming. Weekend days include Aug 3 (Sunday) and Aug 8 (Saturday).

events.title: EleFest: Smithsonian National Zoo Elephant Festival – Family Days
events.price: Free (zoo entry pass required; some ticketed add-ons extra)
events.description: A three-day elephant festival at the Smithsonian National Zoo celebrating the Zoo's newest Asian elephant calf, Linh Mai, and World Elephant Day (Aug. 12). Saturday and Sunday family days (Aug. 8–9) feature elephant-themed activities, cultural performances including traditional Thai dance (Somapa Thai Dance Group, Sat. Aug. 8), community chalk murals (Chalk Riot, Sun. Aug. 9), South Indian dance (Rhythmaya Dance Group), and DC Public Library elephant-themed storytimes and literacy activities. Free zoo entry pass required. Paid ticketed add-ons include Yoga with Elephants ($75, ages 12+).

events.title: EleFest: Yoga with Elephants
events.venue: Smithsonian's National Zoo – Elephant Community Center
events.description: Practice yoga alongside the Zoo's elephant herd inside the Elephant Community Center before the main EleFest festival opens. Bring a yoga mat and water bottle; a complimentary elephant-branded cooling towel is included. Part of the three-day EleFest festival.

events.title: TLC – A New Musical (Working Title)
events.venue: Arena Stage (Fichandler Stage), Mead Center for American Theater
events.price: Tickets vary; under-30 and rush pricing typically available at Arena Stage
events.description: Arena Stage's summer 2026 production running through August 9, with confirmed performances on the Aug 1 and Aug 8 weekends. TLC blazed a trail and changed the game — the trio stormed the '90s in this vibrant stage production. Exact production title to confirm on arenastage.org.

events.title: Escape with Washington Improv Theater
events.description: WIT's 'Escape' series moves to the ground-floor Shargai space at Studio Theatre in the second half of the run. Long-form unscripted improv comedy. Multiple Saturday showtimes. Pay-what-you-can; $20 at door.

events.title: Improv for All! Workshop at Martin Luther King Jr. Library
events.venue: Martin Luther King Jr. Memorial Library – Central Library
events.description: All-ages improv comedy and performance workshop hosted at the MLK Jr. Memorial Library. Multiple sessions also offered at the Capitol View branch. Part of DC Public Library's ongoing summer programming.

events.title: Panda Fest DC 2026
events.time: Sat 10 AM–10 PM; Sun 10 AM–8 PM
events.venue: Pennsylvania Ave NW between 4th & 7th Streets (6th St NW & Pennsylvania Ave NW)
events.description: Panda Fest makes its DC debut — one of the nation's biggest outdoor Asian food and culture festivals. Features 90+ Asian food vendors, 200+ street food offerings, 40+ merchandise vendors, cultural performances, family-friendly activities, and panda-themed fun for all ages. Children under 6 free.

events.title: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History – Free Drop-In Visit
events.venue: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History
events.description: The Smithsonian's National Museum of Natural History offers free daily drop-in access across all three target weekends. Highlights include the Q?rius Science Education Center (ground floor) for hands-on exploration. The museum also hosted Play Date at NMNH (early learners) in August. One of the world's greatest natural history collections, all free.

events.title: DPR Destination Movie Night at Yards Park: Summer Screening
events.venue: Yards Park Great Lawn (355 Water Street SE)
events.description: DC Department of Parks & Recreation Destination Movie Night Series every Thursday through August 20 at Yards Park's Great Lawn. Each night features themed activities at 6 PM (mask making, Pink Party, karaoke, etc.) followed by a movie at 7 PM. Waterfront setting with interactive pre-show experiences tied to each film.

events.title: Military Bands Capitol Summer Concert Series
events.venue: U.S. Capitol West Front (National Mall side)
events.description: Free outdoor concerts by U.S. military bands (Navy Band, Air Force Band, Marine Band, Army Band) on the West Front of the U.S. Capitol. No tickets required. Lawn chairs permitted. Runs select evenings July 13 through August 28, 2026.

events.title: The Notebook – The Musical (National Tour)
events.time: Various (evenings 7:30 PM; matinees on select days)
events.venue: The National Theatre, 1321 Pennsylvania Ave NW
events.description: Based on the best-selling novel that inspired the iconic film, The Notebook is a deeply moving portrait of the enduring power of love, presented as part of Broadway at the National's touring season. Runs through the Aug 22 and Aug 29 weekends.

events.title: Discover Summer for Teens
events.venue: All DC Public Library Neighborhood Branches
events.description: Dedicated teen track of DC Public Library's Discover Summer program. Teens pick up a Bingo Board at any branch or sign up on Beanstack, complete reading and activity challenges, and earn prizes. Runs through the end of August.

events.title: Discover Summer: All-Ages Reading & Learning Program
events.venue: All DC Public Library Neighborhood Branches
events.description: DC Public Library's city-wide summer celebration of reading and learning for all ages. Pick up a Discover Summer Bingo Board at any neighborhood branch or sign up online via Beanstack. Complete activities — visiting museums, reading, attending events — to earn prizes including Washington Nationals giveaways. Themed around America's 250th anniversary.

events.title: USBG "Fierce Flora: Tales of Survival and Demise" Exhibition
events.description: The US Botanic Garden's ongoing exhibition "Fierce Flora: Tales of Survival and Demise" explores remarkable plant adaptations and stories of botanical survival. Free to visit as part of general admission-free Conservatory access.

events.title: Sunset Movies at the Wharf
events.description: Outdoor summer movie series at The Wharf running through September 2. Screenings take place on Wednesday evenings along the SW waterfront — a great summer evening plan with the Potomac as a backdrop.

events.title: Bad Medicine: A Monument to Comedy (Sketch Show)
events.description: Bad Medicine's brand-new hour of sketch comedy takes aim at DC landmarks, political institutions, and cultural icons. Described as 'A Monument to Comedy,' the show satirizes the grandeur and dysfunction of Washington, DC. Playing in the Lounge Showroom at DC Improv.

events.title: Richard O'Brien's The Rocky Horror Show
events.venue: Monumental Theatre Company (venue TBC on atlasarts.org / company site)
events.price: Varies; check TodayTix for rush/lottery pricing
events.description: Monumental Theatre Company's production of the cult classic Rocky Horror Show runs August 22–September 6, 2026, overlapping the Aug 22, Aug 29, and Sep 5 weekends. A celebration of the iconic musical.

events.title: Eastern Market Saturday Market
events.description: Eastern Market's weekly Saturday Market runs along 7th Street SE from Pennsylvania Ave SE to North Carolina Ave SE. Features local farmers, flower and plant vendors, packaged food items, and handcrafted goods from local entrepreneurs. DC's oldest continuously operating open-air market.

events.title: Eastern Market Sunday Market
events.description: Eastern Market's weekly Summer Sunday Market runs June through September featuring local craftsmen, artisans, clothing, and apparel with events in Shed 5. Farmers, artists, crafters, and prepared food sellers along 7th Street SE.

events.title: USBG "America's State Flowers: An America250 Celebration" Exhibition
events.description: A special floral exhibition at the US Botanic Garden celebrating America's 250th anniversary by showcasing all 50 state flowers. On view during summer and featured during the extended evening hours events.

events.title: The Wharf Saturday Farmers Market
events.venue: M Street Landing at The Wharf
events.description: Weekly Saturday farmers market at M Street Landing at The Wharf featuring locally sourced food from regional farmers. Runs Saturdays at the waterfront development.

events.title: "In Pursuit of Life, Liberty & Happiness" – America's 250th Anniversary Exhibition
events.venue: Smithsonian National Museum of American History
events.description: The Smithsonian's National Museum of American History leads the nation's 250th anniversary celebrations with a bold, immersive museum-wide exhibition spanning all three floors (250,000 sq ft) and featuring 250 objects from the 1700s to today. Highlights include Jefferson's writing desk, the 1776 gunboat Philadelphia, and the Star-Spangled Banner. Free admission; a free printed guide available. Live programs, hands-on demos, museum theater, and more run through end of August. DC Public Library hosts a table here as part of Discover Summer.

events.title: ALL THE FEELINGS TOUR: Metric, Broken Social Scene, and Stars
events.description: Triple-bill indie/alt-rock tour featuring Canadian icons Metric, Broken Social Scene, and Stars at The Anthem on the Wharf.

events.title: Marcus D. Wiley – Weekend Headliner
events.description: Marcus D. Wiley headlines the DC Improv in an upcoming weekend run. DC Improv features two showrooms and is downtown near Dupont Circle. All patrons must be 18+ with a 2-item food/beverage minimum.

events.title: WABA Red Line Corridor Group Ride
events.description: WABA-supported group ride along the Red Line Corridor. Part of a summer series of supported rides starting from North Bethesda Metro. All experience levels welcome.

events.title: Lord Huron
events.description: Indie folk-rock band Lord Huron performing at The Anthem on the DC Wharf.

events.title: Community Cooldown Summer Series — Ward 7 Activation at The Fields Pavilion @ RFK
events.venue: The Fields Pavilion @ RFK Campus (401 Oklahoma Ave NE)
events.description: Free community event at The Fields Pavilion @ RFK as part of Events DC's Community Cooldown Summer Series. Ward 7 Activation in partnership with Enjoyee Life Ice, featuring JumpDC Superstars and DJ Chan Don. Free sweets, music, and family-friendly activities for all ages.

events.title: Free Outdoor Movie: Roman Holiday at The Wharf
events.venue: Transit Pier at The Wharf (970 Wharf Street SW)
events.description: Free outdoor screening of Roman Holiday on Transit Pier at The Wharf, presented by Pacifico Beer. Part of The Wharf's summer outdoor movie series on the waterfront.

events.title: Marine Barracks Friday Evening Parade
events.description: A breathtaking 75-minute ceremony showcasing the precision and pride of the Marine Corps, with performances by 'The President's Own' Marine Band, 'The Commandant's Own' Drum & Bugle Corps, and the Silent Drill Platoon. Held every Friday May through August.

events.title: Navy Yard Summer Concert Series: Perfekt Blend (Rescheduled)
events.venue: Yards Park Boardwalk (355 Water Street SE)
events.description: Free Capitol Riverfront Friday Night Concert Series (14th season) at the Yards Park boardwalk on the Anacostia River. Perfekt Blend — a high-energy DC-based band blending Top 40, Motown, funk, pop, and R&B — was rescheduled here after a July air-quality cancellation. Family-friendly lyrics, grassy open space, food and beverages nearby.

events.title: Rock the Dock Free Concert: Salsa Dance Night with Cubano Groove
events.venue: Transit Pier at The Wharf (970 Wharf Street SW)
events.description: Salsa Dance Night featuring Salsa with Silvia and live music by Cubano Groove. Part of the Rock the Dock free summer concert series on the Floating Stage at Transit Pier, presented by Pacifico Beer. All-ages outdoor pier concert with dancing.

events.title: Chesapeake DockDogs Competition at The Wharf
events.description: First-ever DockDogs competition in DC — a full day of high-flying canine athletics on District Pier. Dogs compete for the title of Iron Dog in this nationally sanctioned event. Free for spectators.

events.title: Creative Crypt Artist Session at Congressional Cemetery
events.description: One of Congressional Cemetery's recurring Creative Crypt sessions for artists — a unique creative session held inside the historic cemetery. The August 8 session is the 'chatty' variety, welcoming writers, fabric artists, and anyone seeking a creative nudge in an atmospheric setting.

events.title: DC Public Library Storytimes & Activities at EleFest
events.venue: Smithsonian's National Zoo – Outside Visitors Center (Asia Trail Sign)
events.description: DC Public Library joins EleFest at the National Zoo with their book truck for special elephant-themed storytimes and literacy activities for young readers, as part of their Discover Summer initiative. Free with required zoo entry pass.

events.title: Discover Summer Family Festival at DC Public Library
events.venue: DC Public Library – Branch TBD (see registration link)
events.description: A dedicated Discover Summer Family Festival day, with registration opening August 3. Part of DCPL's all-ages summer celebration with games, activities, and community programming across neighborhood libraries.

events.title: WABA Peirce Mill Ice Cream History Ride
events.description: Bike with WABA instructors to Peirce Mill in Rock Creek Park to learn how ice cream was made before electricity. A family-friendly educational ride.

events.title: WABA Summer Scavenger Ride – Anacostia
events.description: A summer scavenger ride with games, surprises, and splashy fun departing from the Anacostia Skate Pavilion. Free to register.

events.title: Live Concert – The Atlantis (IMP Presents)
events.description: IMP-presented show at The Atlantis on U Street. Artist TBA — tickets on sale; check impconcerts.com for headliner.

events.title: Free Outdoor Movie: 10 Things I Hate About You at The Wharf
events.venue: Transit Pier at The Wharf (970 Wharf Street SW)
events.description: Free outdoor screening of 10 Things I Hate About You on Transit Pier at The Wharf, presented by Pacifico Beer. Waterfront movie night on the pier.

events.title: Inklings New Fantasy Book Club – Takoma Park Neighborhood Library
events.venue: Takoma Park Neighborhood Library, 416 Cedar St. NW
events.description: The Takoma Park Neighborhood Branch Library hosts the "Inklings" New Fantasy Book Club, named in honor of the originator of the fantasy genre. A great option for teen readers interested in speculative fiction.

events.title: Rock the Dock Free Concert: The Experience Band & Show (Go-Go)
events.venue: Transit Pier at The Wharf (970 Wharf Street SW)
events.description: The Experience Band & Show performs Go-Go at The Wharf's free Rock the Dock concert series on the Floating Stage at Transit Pier. Go-Go is DC's native music genre. Presented by Pacifico Beer. All-ages outdoor pier show.

events.title: DC Power FC Season Opener vs. Carolina Ascent
events.description: DC Power FC kicks off their season at home against the Carolina Ascent. High-energy professional soccer at Audi Field near the SW Waterfront.

events.title: Live Concert – 9:30 Club (IMP Presents)
events.description: IMP-presented show at 9:30 Club on Saturday August 15. Artist TBA — tickets available; check 930.com for headliner.

events.title: National Zoo Great Cats Day
events.venue: Smithsonian's National Zoo – Great Cats Exhibit
events.description: Head to the Great Cats exhibit to meet animal keepers, watch special animal feedings, and make cat-themed art. A family-friendly zoo event at the Smithsonian's National Zoo.

events.title: Jay Pharoah – Weekend Headliner
events.description: Jay Pharoah, known for his run on Saturday Night Live and unmatched celebrity impressions, headlines the DC Improv for a second weekend engagement. Multiple shows Friday–Sunday. 18+ with 2-item minimum.

events.title: Story Time with DC Public Library at National Museum of American History
events.venue: Smithsonian National Museum of American History, 1300 Constitution Ave NW
events.ageRestriction: Designed for ages 5 and under, all welcome
events.description: The National Museum of American History hosts a monthly Story Time in collaboration with the DC Public Library. Children and caregivers enjoy a story to explore language and literacy skills. Designed for learners ages 5 and under, but all are welcome. Free with museum admission (museum is free).

events.title: USBG Summer Evening Hours with Live Music – August Edition
events.description: The US Botanic Garden stays open until 8pm for a special summer evening with live music by Breonna Shardé, blending soul, jazz, bossa nova, and disco in a high-energy performance. Enjoy golden hour and sunset among summer blooms and the America's State Flowers: An America250 Celebration exhibit. Non-alcoholic mocktails, lemonade, and snacks available for purchase from Vintage Views. Note: The original August date was rescheduled to August 27 due to the Freedom 250 Grand Prix. Free admission; no tickets required.

events.title: Chxrry
events.description: Chxrry performs at Pearl Street Warehouse on the Friday night of the Aug 29 weekend. 21+ venue.

events.title: LaVar Walker – Stand-Up Comedy
events.description: LaVar Walker, an American stand-up comedian, writer, and pharmacist who has appeared on television and toured nationally, headlines Arlington Cinema & Drafthouse. 7 PM show. 21+ unless with a parent. 2903 Columbia Pike, Arlington, VA.

events.title: Pump Action
events.description: Pump Action plays Pearl Street Warehouse. Doors at 7pm, show at 8pm. 21+ venue per venue policy.

events.title: Social Distortion with Descendents and The Chats
events.description: Punk rock triple-bill: Social Distortion headlining with support from Descendents and The Chats at The Anthem. Friday of the Sep 5 weekend.

events.title: Nick Thune – Stand-Up Comedy
events.description: Nick Thune, actor/comedian/writer known for his deadpan delivery and absurdist storytelling, headlines Arlington Cinema & Drafthouse. 7 PM show. 21+ unless with a parent. 2903 Columbia Pike, Arlington, VA.

events.title: Pete Correale – DC Improv Headlining Debut
events.description: Pete Correale, co-host of The Pete and Sebastian Show and veteran of The Tonight Show, Letterman, and Conan, makes his DC Improv headlining debut this fall. Multiple shows over the weekend. 18+ with 2-item minimum.
